dialogues.speaker: Bleu
dialogues.text: What's all this? You lost the Bulle Fruit along the way!?

dialogues.speaker: Blanc
dialogues.text: Calm down! Just head back and pick some...

dialogues.speaker: Bleu
dialogues.text: Goodness! You really don't know how important these supplies are?

dialogues.speaker: Bleu
dialogues.text: We've spent so much time getting ready, I really don't want any more hassle with these Bulle Fruit.

dialogues.speaker: Blanc
dialogues.text: Alright, I've got it. We need to bury the prepared supplies near the Rainbow Rose, for whoever needs help.

dialogues.speaker: Bleu
dialogues.text: So you still remember the job Boss Rouge gave us...

dialogues.speaker: Blanc
dialogues.text: Of course I remember! Boss Rouge is a real gent!

dialogues.speaker: Blanc
dialogues.text: But... I have to say, we ought to do this happily, and with a chivalrous heart.

dialogues.speaker: Blanc
dialogues.text: Don't look so sad, Bleu. Cheer up.

dialogues.speaker: Bleu
dialogues.text: Okay. Last one. Be a bit more careful this time, and don't leave anything out again.
